name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the side, or a bottom sheet on phones, for detail and edit views beside the page.

when: Viewing or editing a record while keeping the list in view.

keyboard.does: Closes, asking first when there are unsaved changes.

builtIn: Unsaved changes ask before closing in a real nested modal.
The bottom sheet has a grip to expand or close.
